codility_new_assessment_trigger.description: Runs for each new assessment in Codility. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

codility_new_session_trigger.description: Runs for each new assessment session in Codility. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

codility_session_cancelled_trigger.description: Runs each time an assessment session is canceled in Codility. Ones canceled before the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

codility_session_completed_trigger.description: Runs each time an assessment session is completed in Codility. Ones completed before the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.
